name: Bryan Battle
profileSummary: Bryan Christopher Battle is an American professional mixed martial artist, who competes in the Middleweight division of the Professional Fighters League (PFL). A professional since 2019, Battle was the middleweight tournament winner in the 29th season of The Ultimate Fighter and went 7-1 in the promotion. As of April 21, 2026, he is #8 in the PFL middleweight rankings.
